config.label: EVM private key (32 bytes hex)
config.description: EVM private key (32 bytes hex). Required for buyer tools (call_api, get_wallet_balance, estimate_cost). Stays on the user's machine.

config.label: Optional runtime spend cap in USD; call_api throws BUDGET_EXHAUSTED when reached
config.description: Optional runtime spend cap in USD; call_api throws BUDGET_EXHAUSTED when reached.

config.label: Network identifier
config.description: Network identifier. Defaults to eip155:8453 (Base mainnet). Use eip155:84532 for Sepolia testnet.

config.label: Personal access token (gfpat_
config.description: Personal access token (gfpat_...) from gatefare.io/dashboard/tokens. Required for publisher tools (register_api, list_my_apis, update_api, get_revenue, distribute).

config.label: Override the Gatefare base URL (defaults to https://gatefare
config.description: Override the Gatefare base URL (defaults to https://gatefare.io). Useful for self-hosted deployments.
